title: A deactivated pinned technician shows 'No work orders'; one removed from this location gets no column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • [User-B]: a role with Work orders > View only (Create & Edit off), signed in in a second browser or a private window.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. Both users use it.
  • Technicians "Jenny Wilson" (leading no work order) and "Theresa Webb" (leading only [WO-2] below) and [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard") at this location (the expected results name Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb, so keep these names). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • Two Approved work orders for that customer: [WO-1] led by [Tech-A], and [WO-2] led by Theresa Webb.
  • Both [User-A] and [User-B] have Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb pinned in Board View (pins are per user).
  • What must hold: Jenny Wilson is active, Theresa Webb is at this location and leads [WO-2] at the start; steps 1 and 2 change that, and both are restored afterwards.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as "Jenny Wilson" (keep this name, the expected results use it); "Theresa Webb" (keep this name, the expected results use it); [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat once more, so there are two; record them as [WO-1] and [WO-2] (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  5. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1] = [Tech-A], [WO-2] = Theresa Webb.
  6. Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone View Role") > turn on Work Orders view, leave Work Orders create and edit off > Save.
  7. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member with an email you can open (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone Viewer"), role = the new role, at least one Department (required), with this location picked in Location > Save & Close, then accept the invitation and set a password. Record this user as [User-B] and keep it signed in in a second browser (or a private window).
  8. As [User-A], and again as [User-B], open Work Orders > Board View and pin Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb (pins are per user).
  9. Check the setup worked: for both users, Board View shows Jenny Wilson and Theresa Webb right after Unassigned with filled pins; Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone shows [WO-1] led by [Tech-A] and [WO-2] led by Theresa Webb. If not, fix it before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Deactivate Jenny Wilson: Settings > Staff > Jenny Wilson's edit icon > click Deactivate Account and confirm.
  2. Remove Theresa Webb from this location: Settings > Staff > Theresa Webb's edit icon > remove this location from her Location field > Save.
  3. Click Work Orders in the top menu.
  4. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar, click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Pinned Gone.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  6. Read the pinned Jenny Wilson column, then find Theresa Webb's column and read its header.
  7. Try to drag the [WO-1] card onto Jenny Wilson's column.
  8. Drag the [WO-2] card from Theresa Webb's column onto the Unassigned column.
  9. Read the board again.
  10. In the second browser, as [User-B], open Work Orders in Board View.
  11. Read the pinned columns.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: Jenny Wilson's column is still shown right after Unassigned (the pin is kept), marked inactive and empty. For your user (who can reassign) it shows "No work orders", not "Drag a work order here to assign it". Theresa Webb is not among the pinned columns: she appears further along as an ordinary column holding [WO-2], with no pin icon in her header.
  • Step 7: the card cannot be dropped on Jenny Wilson's column.
  • Step 9: [WO-2] is in Unassigned and Theresa Webb has no column at all. Her pin only counts at locations where she is enrolled.
  • Step 11: for the view-only user, Jenny Wilson's column also shows "No work orders", and there is no Theresa Webb column.
  • Afterwards, set Jenny Wilson active again, add this location back to Theresa Webb, then make her the lead of [WO-2] again (Lead Technician on the work order page) to restore the data.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030 v44, edited 9 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R20a, S3-R20b, S3-N4, S4-N5, read 9 Oct 2026. S3-R20b follows Sasha Grosman's answer to SQ-11 (PRD footer comment, 24 Sep 2026), confirmed by Chris Ward on 9 Oct 2026. Tech plan 3.13.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R20a: “The empty column of a pinned technician who has been deactivated shows “No work orders” to every user, because nothing can be dropped there (S4-N5).”
  • S3-R20b: “A pinned technician who is not enrolled at this location gets no column here. If they still lead work orders at this location, they appear as a normal, unpinned column holding that work.”
  • S3-N4: “Show an inactive indicator on deactivated technician columns.”
  • S4-N5: “Nothing can be dropped onto an inactive technician's column/group (S2-N2, S3-N2).”

Updated 9 Oct 2026 for PRD v44 (S3-R20a narrowed, S3-R20b added); not yet re-run on the QA build.
